summary: This note covers the end of Hollywood Video, the video rental chain. Its operations ceased in May 2010 after parent company Movie Gallery declared Chapter 7 bankruptcy. The last US store closed on July 31, 2010, and the last official Canadian store closed on August 8, 2010.
one_line: Hollywood Video, the video rental chain, ceased operations in 2010 after parent Movie Gallery filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy.
key_facts: Hollywood Video ceased operations in May 2010.
Movie Gallery was the parent company of Hollywood Video.
Movie Gallery declared Chapter 7 bankruptcy in May 2010.
The last Hollywood Video store in the US closed on July 31, 2010.
The last official Hollywood Video store in Canada closed on August 8, 2010.
